CA.name: Spreading dogbane
CA.citation: US Forest Service Plant of the Week; native range confirmed across all 10 Canadian provinces. Distinguished from Apocynum cannabinum (Indian hemp)

DE.name: Gewoehnliches Hundsgift
DE.citation: German Wikipedia genus article; giftpflanzen.com; Hortipedia. Clearly distinguished from Indianischer Hanf/Hanfartiger Hundswuerger (A. cannabinum) and Venezianisches Hundsgift (A. venetum). Genuine German phytotherapy history for cardiac conditions documented in Madaus (1938, via Henriette's Herbal)

US.name: Spreading dogbane
US.citation: US Forest Service Plant of the Week; Lady Bird Johnson Wildflower Center. SAFETY: contains cardenolides (cymarin); toxic to dogs, humans and livestock
